title: Light Primavera Pasta
description: This easy light primavera pasta recipe includes penne, zucchini, squash, and a light Parmesan peppercorn dressing, and it's ready in about 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package penne pasta (such as Barilla® Plus)
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 (16 ounce) bottle light Parmesan-peppercorn dressing (such as Cains®)

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain.

Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add olive oil; heat for about 30 seconds. Add yellow squash, zucchini, and garlic; cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Season lightly with salt and black pepper. Transfer to a large serving bowl.
Stir penne into vegetable mixture; add dressing and toss to coat. Serve hot or cold.
